newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian paramilitaries kill four, snatch others.
newsitem.headline: Colombian paramilitaries kill four, snatch others.

text.p: A suspected right-wing death squad killed four peasants and dragged off another four in northern Colombia early on Monday, police said.
A group of heavily-armed men raided a farm near the town of San Diego in Cesar province and attacked the peasants, accusing them of collaborating with leftist guerrillas, a police spokesman said.

The so-called Peasant Self-Defence Group of Cordoba and Uraba (ACCU), the country's most-feared paramilitary squad, is thought to have been behind the attack. Police said they were trying to rescue the kidnapped peasants.

In a separate attack over the weekend, suspected ACCU members dragged three men from a bus, shot them dead and disfigured their corpses with acid in northwest Antioquia province, Bogota's El Tiempo newspaper reported.
Right-wing death squads and leftist rebels are locked in a bitter fight for territorial and political control over much of northern Colombia.
Scores of suspected leftist sympathisers have been killed in recent months and many communities have been transformed into virtual ghost towns as their inhabitants flee.
